description: This file defines the class FactorAuthEmailCode, which implements email-based two-factor authentication. It provides methods to display an email token input form, send a token via email, and validate email templates used for 2FA.

classes.name: FactorAuthEmailCode
classes.description: A class implementing email-based two-factor authentication, including methods for showing input UI, sending tokens via email, and validating email templates.

methods.name: showTokenInput
methods.description: Displays an HTML form for the user to input their email token during login.

methods.name: sendToken
methods.description: Sends an email containing a token to the user for two-factor authentication using a predefined email template.

methods.name: validateTokenMessage
methods.description: Validates that the email template used for two-factor authentication contains a '$code' placeholder.
